Show a thick curved tail stem ending in two large rounded horizontally spreading whale flukes with a central notch. The tail curls around behind the tiny body, with a large unobstructed section visible beside her, its fluke span at least as wide as her HEAD. Tail should be a dominant readable silhouette, approximately half the hair-and-body silhouette area; fully show both flukes and their connection to the stem. Deep navy blue, simple cel shading. Do NOT omit or hide the whale tail behind hair or crop it.
7. Extremely compact Q-version SUPER-DEFORMED proportions: oversized head about 55–60% of the character height excluding tail, tiny torso, tiny short limbs, roughly TWO HEADS TALL in total. NOT the tall 3-head body of a standard anime maid.
Style: match original's restrained small-sprite anime linework, simple flat cel shading, compact readable shapes, cute large head and tiny body. Avoid detailed rendering and added ornament.
Composition: exactly ONE whole character, ONE pose, entire hair, feet AND enormous tail visible with clear transparent padding on all sides; tail placed to the left behind the character and emerging beyond the hair silhouette when the pose permits. No scenery, no window, no floor shadow, no typography, no speech bubbles, no punctuation marks, no detached accents, no panel, no grid, no watermark. Genuinely transparent RGBA background.
Only change the pose described next; keep the seven locked traits.
Pose: WALKING RIGHT. Three-quarter right view, tiny short legs with one small foot taking a modest step and the other trailing; arms swing gently. Blue eyes open, small pleased smile. Giant whale tail arcs out behind toward the LEFT, both wide rounded flukes clearly visible, distinct from the flowing gradient hair. Full character and tail, no exaggerated long stride or long legs.
